card.name: Inside drug names, partway through
card.fires_on: The middle or end piece of a longer drug name, such as the ext in dextroamphetamine, ex in sugammadex, or ole in aripiprazole. Also a few word endings in warning lists, like status or fever.

modes.label: Drug name pieces
modes.description: A middle or final piece of a long generic drug name in warnings or contraindications.

modes.label: Ending of a condition phrase
modes.description: The last word of a listed condition, such as status after cardiovascular or fever after hay.
modes.example: unstable cardiovascular<< status>> in acute hemorrhage; severe ulcerative

card.writes: No clear meaning; it nudges toward word-ending pieces and away from symptom and similar words.
card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long drug names like dextroamphetamine and sugammadex.
